authorInfo.bio: George Parsons Lathrop (1851–1898) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Rose and Roof-Tree — Poems by George Parsons Lathrop" is a collection of poetry written in the late 19th century, likely during the Victorian era. The book explores themes of nature, love, loss, and personal reflection, offering a lyrical examination of emotional experiences through vivid imagery and metaphor.
